label: fix S9 r1
result:
I fixed 28 of the 31 blockers in the files I own; the other 3 still need server work. The S9 check passes, but test_flow does not print "all good": it fails inside `server/checks/s8.py` (Compete), which I did not touch. That failure looks date-dependent (details under "Needs another owner"). I changed only web files.

Branch v2/s9 was rebased onto master (master had only spec commits) and has 6 new commits (9318194..e96f351). Everything is committed and the worktree is detached. Nothing had been fixed before I started. I checked the pages in headless Chromium at 1440, 1280, 900 and 390 with a seeded learner and a fresh one. The dark-theme screenshot came out light, so dark mode is not verified.

**Fixed:**
- **Sort run:** the counter looked items up by object, so it read "-1". It now looks them up by id and reads "1 of 10 · about N min left". The same bug made the flashcard "N left" line and Words check's "Question N of M" wrong, and made "mixed" card fronts ignore the rotation; those are fixed too.
- **Placement and sort answers:** three equal neutral buttons in a 3-column grid, so "Not sure" no longer wraps at 390.
- **Quiz:**
  - Option A no longer gets a focus ring on load; focus goes to the question container and keys still work.
  - The verdict now names the kind of miss instead of repeating the option's rationale.
  - The right count stays hidden until the first right answer.
  - Open word's "O" key is set in the sans font so it doesn't read as 0.
  - "Again today" comes first in the actions row and the dispute link sits apart at the right.
- **Result:**
  - Chips read "account · explanation".
  - When every word shares a date, it is said once in the heading ("all 3 back today").
  - Words due today are taken out of the "tomorrow" count.
  - By type is hidden when the run had one type, and the score is in the sans display font.
  - Up next is "Review N due" / "10 new" / Library, all 44px.
- **"Most nearly means" items with a blank:** the label changes to "In context" and the question becomes the standard complete-the-text wording, in the word sheet sample and in the runner.
- **One orange button per screen:**
  - Library: strip Review and Spread become plain buttons; Flashcards turns orange only once a filter, search or selection is active.
  - Study and My words: Today's words is one line with a plain "Start today's words" button.
- **Library study bar:** it appears only when the grid is in view or the view is narrowed. On phones it is one 56px row, and its help text is the Flashcards tooltip. The header, grid count and bar now count words the same way (1,325).
- **"52 due" repeats:** removed from the header, the Review button, the reason line (when it restates the facts), the legend and the All tile.
- **Row heights:** one 44px height per row (Today card, bar, sheet footers, hook, header, runner controls, Up next). Quiet buttons in those rows no longer paint their hover box over neighbours.
- **Grid tiles:** one line with an ellipsis and a tooltip; the kicker always shows the part of speech, with the sense muted in the title; no per-tile "est." (the legend has an ⓘ).
- **Filter chips:** they show a value only when set, and Select sits beside the count on row 1 at 1280.
- **Strip:**
  - A tile with no daily item is dropped; an answered one shows the word, your result and "New one tomorrow".
  - New today reads "31 / 10 ✓" with "Goal met" under it, and the kicker is shortened to "Transition".
  - A fresh learner sees only the daily items.
- **By exam day:**
  - Headline: "N words at risk by Dec 5" with a Review them button.
  - The jargon line now reads "To learn: SAT core · advanced · transitions".
  - The chips no longer wrap or overlap the kicker.
  - On Library it starts folded to one line and remembers when opened.
- **Collection tiles** share one grid (6 across at 1040px), always reserve the known bar, and Roots reads "119 roots · 349 words" with one "roots known" count.
- **Study setup:**
  - Segmented controls are only as wide as their options.
  - The glance shows the count big, the minutes under it and one recap line.
  - Below 1000px it is a bar at the bottom, so Start is always in reach.
  - Empty decks sit under a "4 more decks (empty)" fold, with their sentence as a tooltip.
  - Help text moved into ⓘ tooltips, and Timer, Method and Move on are under a remembered "More options" fold.
  - How many ends in "All" on both pages.
- **My words:**
  - A new learner sees only "Your words live here" with Library, Add a word and Bring words ▾.
  - Tiles that would show 0 are skipped, and their explanations moved to tooltips.
  - Tools are Add a word, Bring words ▾ (with Import inside) and ⋯ (Export, Print, Share a list, Grade a worksheet).
  - Difficulty is now a dropdown, so the filter row stays on one line with Table/Wall aligned on it. I did this instead of the suggested "Filters ▾" popover.
  - The forecast's today bar includes overdue words and is labelled "Today", ticks are whole numbers, and the meta says "1 day".
- **Word sheet:**
  - The footer is "Practice 10 like this" (orange), "Flashcards from here" and a 44px ⋯ holding "Quiz with lookalikes" and Reset. It fits one row at 390.
  - The sample has one kicker ("SAT-style · In context") and the = / ≠ rows are centred.
  - The block is renamed "Easy to mix up", with "abate or subside?" headings and "Quiz abate vs subside (6)".
  - Your record keeps the ladder and drops the dot row.
  - The shades help is an ⓘ, with a thin weak-to-strong gradient under the chips.
- **Lists:** they are read from each word's `lists` as well as own words' collections, and a list you just made shows up at once in this session.

**Needs another owner:**
- **Lists (server, words.library):** a new list disappears on reload. `/api/words` must fill each word's `lists` from the `word_lists` table.
- **Mislabelled items (server sample builder):** build "nearly" items with the word left in the text, or label them in-context. The pages now guard against it.
- **Distractors (server `quiz_item`):** leave out choices from the target's family, synonyms or "Same as" list. The worksheet Q3 double-correct answer is still live; the pages can't fix it.
- **Result schedule (`server/api_words.py` `_summary`):** words due today are counted under "tomorrow" (`left <= 1`); add a "today" bucket. The page corrects this for learning words with a marked `ponytail:` comment.
- **Trap names:** "meaning" is not in the traps catalogue; I gave it the label "Different meaning" on the page.
- **Compete check (`server/checks/s8.py`, around line 519):** `compete.contest("final-" + next SAT date)` returns 404 for today's date, which stops test_flow.
- **Shell, not in these pages:** the "Hold a tab for shortcuts" toast still covers phone bottom bars, and the Sign in banner's Dismiss button overlaps its neighbour.
